decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=REPLY, dst=/net/downlink/a/net/downlink/cli/reply-ep, src=/sensor/temp, kind=ERROR, ERROR{ VALUE u16=0x0020 tr::path::not_found } } — the fwd-reply-error frame with the STATUS wrapper removed: a bare ERROR as a kind=ERROR reply's payload, which is not a reply error spelling
decoded.note: RFC-0004 §B pins a kind=ERROR reply's payload as a STATUS carrying the ERROR; reference/05 §0x08 once also admitted a bare ERROR there, and the RFC-0004 erratum of 2026-10-08 (#1983) removed that. A reader MUST NOT surface this frame as an error identity: it reads no code and no tr:: path, exactly as for a STATUS carrying no ERROR. The codec still round-trips the bytes; the refusal is the reader's. Emitters never produce it.
